{{Quote|I'm not the Darillian I was before the Lusankya fled Coruscant and my wife died in the disaster that followed. I'm certainly not the compressed set of data in your memory that you think is Captain Darillian.|Garik Loran, impersonating Zurel Darillian, to Apwar Trigit|<ref name="WS" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zurel Darillian]]. She [[Death/Legends|died]] when [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] [[Mission above Imperial City|launched]] the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' from its berth on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], destroying the building the Darillians called home.<ref name="WS" />
